edits.before: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Assassin's Path has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — 17s at rank 1, 13s max. Walk out before the stun arms; when it's down that whole window is your all-in. - Hextech Ray is 12s early: a whiffed laser is a free WQ trade. - Your R is 100s at rank 1 — spend it on kill windows, never on poke.

edits.before: W on the contact, Q the gap, auto for the bleed, walk through the return — three stacks of rent he paid for one trade.
edits.after: His Siphon Power auto-reset is the step-up tell — W it, Q the gap, auto the third stack, and back off before W drops.

edits.before: Q-leaping into a held CC for style — Talon without the gap-closer is a roamer stuck in traffic.
edits.after: An uncrashed wave feeds Viktor free Hex Fragments while you're gone — his evolutions arrive early.

edits.before: Viktor wins by landing Gravity Field, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Viktor wins by surviving to two items: Gravity Field walls the dive, Hextech Ray shoves, evolutions out-scale you.

edits.before: Viktor is one of the weakest early champions — no mobility, mana-hungry, and reliant on landing Death Ray (E) to trade. Walk up outside the laser angle, Rake, then WQ blink; his only peel is the W Gravity Field, which takes time to root and is easy to dash out of with Path.
edits.after: Viktor is one of the weakest early champions — no mobility, mana-hungry, and reliant on landing Hextech Ray (E) to trade. Walk up outside the laser angle, Rake, then WQ blink; his only peel is the W Gravity Field, which takes time to stun and is easy to dash out of with Path.

edits.before: Your Bladeflurry all-in kills him before his upgraded Death Ray and Chaos Storm can zone you. Save E for the moment W's gravity field starts pulsing so you never get stunned, then R rings plus WQ deletes an unfinished Viktor.
edits.after: Your Shadow Assault all-in kills him before his upgraded Hextech Ray and Arcane Storm can zone you. Save E for the moment W's gravity field starts pulsing so you never get stunned, then R rings plus WQ deletes an unfinished Viktor.

edits.before: Fully evolved Viktor out-ranges and out-zones you: Chaos Storm, a wave-clearing Death Ray, and Gravity Field wall him off in fights. Once he has 2+ items you must flank and one-shot him instantly rather than duel through his zone control.
edits.after: Fully evolved Viktor out-ranges and out-zones you: Arcane Storm, a wave-clearing Hextech Ray, and Gravity Field wall him off in fights. Once he has 2+ items you must flank and one-shot him instantly rather than duel through his zone control.

edits.before: Viktor is a free lane early — immobile, mana-starved, and dependent on hitting Death Ray to do anything. Levels 1-2 sidestep the laser and punish with Rake poke; he cannot contest your W+Q spike and has no dash to escape it.
edits.after: Viktor is a free lane early — immobile, mana-starved, and dependent on hitting Hextech Ray to do anything. Levels 1-2 sidestep the laser and punish with Rake poke; he cannot contest your W+Q spike and has no dash to escape it.

edits.before: Once Viktor completes his core and evolves, the lane flips — a fully online Viktor zones you out with Chaos Storm and long-range Death Ray and walls off dives with W. From 2 items on, stop duelling through his zone and instead flank to one-shot him before he reacts.
edits.after: Once Viktor completes his core and evolves, the lane flips — a fully online Viktor zones you out with Arcane Storm and long-range Hextech Ray and walls off dives with W. From 2 items on, stop duelling through his zone and instead flank to one-shot him before he reacts.
